allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Max Simkin repairs shoes in the same New York shop that has been in his family for generations. Disenchanted with the grind of daily life, Max stumbles upon a magical heirloom that allows him to step into the lives of his customers and see the world in a new way. Sometimes walking in another man's shoes is the only way one can discover who they really are.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When an ordinary cobbler gains the power to inhabit anyone whose shoes he mends, what will living as other people reveal about his own life?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Weary of his daily routine in his family's generational New York repair shop, Max Simkin unearths a magical heirloom that lets him step into the lives of his customers and experience the city from new perspectives.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Engaged and thoughtful, mixing gentle fantasy with comedic warmth and grounded drama for an introspective solo watch.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Tom McCarthy, this offbeat fable blends comedy and urban drama, using a whimsical body-swapping conceit to explore identity and quiet self-discovery.
